terms.label: Applicant is a consumer
terms.definition: The trader's CRM records the counter-party as a consumer (non-professional).

anchors.quote: Tarbija võib sidevahendi abil sõlmitud lepingust taganeda põhjust avaldamata 14 päeva jooksul.
anchors.note: Only consumers enjoy the withdrawal right.

terms.label: Contract was concluded by means of distance communication
terms.definition: The order form stored by the trader marks the contract as a distance sale (e-shop, phone, etc.).

anchors.note: Withdrawal only applies to distance contracts.

terms.label: Subject of the contract falls into a § 53 lg 4 excluded category
terms.definition: The product catalogue flags the goods as custom-made / perishable / hygiene-sealed, etc.

anchors.quote: Käesoleva seaduse § 56 lõikes 1 sätestatud taganemisõigust ei kohaldata lepingule, mille esemeks on ...
anchors.note: Category-based exclusion blocks the withdrawal right.

terms.label: The 14-day withdrawal period is still running
terms.definition: Consumer confirms that fewer than 14 days have elapsed since receipt of the goods / conclusion of the contract.

terms.label: Withdrawal notice has been sent in time
terms.definition: Consumer confirms that the withdrawal notice was dispatched to the trader before the 14-day period expired.

anchors.quote: Loetakse, et tarbija on sidevahendi abil sõlmitud lepingust taganenud tähtaegselt, kui ta on ettevõtjale selle kohta teate ära saatnud taganemistähtaja jooksul.
